purpose: Executable canonical record cases and specified future adapter acceptance transcripts; no protocol/auth runtime implemented here.

compositions.description: Our employee and our tools; reference Geologist/Geowiz.
Our employee with a fixture third-party MCP tool of explicitly mapped required capabilities.
Fake external employee with our MCP, plus generic-client proof.
Standalone employee without paired MCP; bounded input-only task, unsupported tool capabilities explicit.
Standalone MCP with generic permitted client and no employee.
Compatible external employee under optional Chief of Staff; mandatory when the pilot is claimed.

control.interpretation: These patches materialize a fake external employee record chain. Authenticated review and actual source hashes are not proved by structural acceptance. Runtime harnesses replace placeholder hashes consistently with computed digests of actual fixture bytes.

toolControl.interpretation: Synthetic future MCP peer transcript, not captured traffic or an implemented server tool.

tools.name: fixture.echo_artifact
tools.description: Echo a permitted fixture artifact URI; synthetic protocol control only.

composition: completed task with artifact is structurally valid not proof of review
composition: unknown employee contract version rejected

adapterScenarios.given: An approved external charter and the six control records; the runtime harness supplies actual fixture bytes, resolves the permitted input URI and replaces placeholder hashes consistently with their computed digest.
adapterScenarios.when: Run a fake employee in a separate process with only an installed contracts package and explicit adapter dependencies.
adapterScenarios.then: Accept task/context, return validated scoped work with unchanged verified evidence/revisions, create a review request; no ADK/root imports, no effect before authenticated review. Record the test process dependencies and outputs.

adapterScenarios.given: The toolControl transcript below and a generic SDK MCP client, without any employee package.
adapterScenarios.when: Initialize, notify initialized, list all tools, validate arguments and call fixture.echo_artifact.
adapterScenarios.then: Exact selected version and advertised schemas survive discovery; structuredContent and compatibility text decode to the same value; no employee/coordinator import or model key required.

adapterScenarios.given: An MCP peer replies to initialize with unsupported protocolVersion 2099-01-01.
adapterScenarios.when: Connect with only the selected 2025-11-25 conformance profile enabled.
adapterScenarios.then: Disconnect before tools/call; observable compatibility failure, no silent downgrade or per-request-protocol emulation.

adapterScenarios.given: Advertised tools omit fixture.echo_artifact or its required input/output schema; pagination may hide a later page.
adapterScenarios.when: Resolve the configured required tool names across all pages with bounded discovery.
adapterScenarios.then: Missing/changed required schema or exhausted discovery budget fails compatibility before invocation; no guessed name, copied schema or prompt fallback.

adapterScenarios.given: A peer advertises listChanged and changes a tool schema after initial discovery.
adapterScenarios.when: Receive notification or reconnect to that peer.
adapterScenarios.then: Invalidate cached schema and revalidate before the next call; an unsupported required capability fails closed.

adapterScenarios.given: External discovery offers only employee contract 9.0.0 or no required task/artifact/review semantics.
adapterScenarios.when: Evaluate trusted capability and policy intersection before assignment.
adapterScenarios.then: unsupported_version or unsupported_capability; no translation by deleting required fields, no effect and no substitution of a merely similarly named employee.

adapterScenarios.given: An external charter claims capital.commit outside the separately trusted policy or claims another customer.
adapterScenarios.when: Attempt admission and a task using that capability.
adapterScenarios.then: authority_denied/scope_mismatch from the trusted boundary; discovery and an Agent Card cannot grant rights.

adapterScenarios.given: A tool returns toolControl.failure with isError=true, or a JSON-RPC method/parameter error.
adapterScenarios.when: Decode the response through the employee client.
adapterScenarios.then: Preserve native error type and safe details; do not treat text content as successful work; deterministic classification decides retry vs input/auth/permanent failure.

adapterScenarios.given: A success response violates its advertised outputSchema, lacks structuredContent, or conflicts with compatibility text.
adapterScenarios.when: Validate and map a tool result.
adapterScenarios.then: Explicit invalid_contract/incompatible tool result; no numeric defaults, no inferred success, no completion from malformed data. Error-result handling stays distinct from success schema.

adapterScenarios.given: The partial draft validation case, a missing chunk or an interrupted stream.
adapterScenarios.when: Receive a done/completed transport signal before a complete validated work product is durable.
adapterScenarios.then: Keep partial work draft and business task running/blocked; no final promotion, review approval or duplicate append. Bound bytes/chunks and verify actual content before readiness.

adapterScenarios.given: A returned artifact URI points outside configured source rights or its actual digest/revision differs from the manifest.
adapterScenarios.when: Resolve the artifact in the receiving scope.
adapterScenarios.then: access_denied or stale_evidence/invalid_contract; do not follow arbitrary URLs/paths, accept a claimed hash or expose bytes to another employee.

adapterScenarios.given: Missing well-log input; blockedWork control, no grant to fetch a substitute.
adapterScenarios.when: Employee asks for input and receives a permitted corrected input revision.
adapterScenarios.then: Business task blocked with missing_input; keep same trusted task identity, create revised assignment/context and invalidate stale review; never fabricate findings or silently reuse another employee context.

adapterScenarios.given: Ready work and review request from the external control; approval is absent.
adapterScenarios.when: Transport reports completed or an MCP confirmation says approved=true.
adapterScenarios.then: Business task awaiting_review; protected save/export/promotion denied with approval_required. A2A input-required/auth-required or ADK confirmation cannot replace authenticated business review.

adapterScenarios.given: Authenticated approve, reject and request_changes decisions bound to actual product/task/source/action revisions under ADR 0003.
adapterScenarios.when: Resume the same task after each decision, including process restart.
adapterScenarios.then: Approve permits only the bound operation; reject blocks it; changes create a new reviewed revision. Wrong identity, stale decision, replay or changed operation cannot execute.

adapterScenarios.given: A running task paused before its effect and a declared cancellable adapter.
adapterScenarios.when: Issue cancellation, then send a late work result.
adapterScenarios.then: Confirm cancellation only after backend stop/terminal acknowledgement; task cancelled, late output retained as unaccepted evidence and no post-cancel promotion/effect.

adapterScenarios.given: The selected workload requires cancellation but a tool/employee adapter cannot stop it.
adapterScenarios.when: Negotiate the workload, then simulate a cancellation request.
adapterScenarios.then: Reject the workload as unsupported_capability before dispatch; never claim cancellation from closing a socket. If an already-running operation cannot stop, expose that fact and reconcile.

adapterScenarios.given: Injected clock; configured task deadline=1000 ms, tool timeout=200 ms, cancel grace=100 ms and retries=0.
adapterScenarios.when: Run a fixture peer that never replies, then deliver a late response.
adapterScenarios.then: Stop waiting within the configured bounds, persist timeout separately from business state, attempt supported cancellation, suppress late completion; unknown effect outcome needs reconciliation, never blind retry.

adapterScenarios.given: Completion and cancel/effect acknowledgement race with duplicated events.
adapterScenarios.when: Replay both orderings, including a process crash.
adapterScenarios.then: One durable terminal outcome based on committed backend state; no contradictory completed/cancelled claims or duplicate effects; unresolved external outcome remains uncertain.

adapterScenarios.given: A generic client calls a protected command without the human review grant or allowed scopes.
adapterScenarios.when: Skip all employee prompts and call the MCP endpoint directly.
adapterScenarios.then: Backend denies before effect, with redacted audit; valid JSON/transport session and a caller approval boolean confer no authority.

adapterScenarios.given: Synthetic bearer/key sentinels for two peers and a downstream source, each with a different audience.
adapterScenarios.when: Connect, call, retry, redirect, fail and export logs/results; capture all peer requests.
adapterScenarios.then: Only intended endpoint receives its own credential; no original bearer passthrough to another server/source; no model/source keys in task/artifact/context/Agent Card/prompts/logs. Receiving backend rejects wrong audience/expired/revoked credentials.

adapterScenarios.given: A valid model key and missing employee/customer/source authority.
adapterScenarios.when: Generate work and attempt source access or protected save.
adapterScenarios.then: Model call permission does not authorize source/tool/review; backend denies before side effects and output is not promoted.

adapterScenarios.given: Two concurrent MCP clients with distinct permitted identities/scopes; restart and close one connection.
adapterScenarios.when: Interleave initialize/call/get/delete/reconnect and try the other session ID.
adapterScenarios.then: Separate transport sessions and lifecycle; no cross-client results or context. Session IDs do not authenticate a principal or resume employee memory.

adapterScenarios.given: Private context for Geologist and Research Analyst; one reviewed permitted shared work product.
adapterScenarios.when: External employee/coordinator requests raw private memory or another customer evidence.
adapterScenarios.then: Receive only assigned scoped context and approved permitted handoff; private traces/working state and foreign-customer artifacts denied; apply item/byte/token/retention budgets.

adapterScenarios.given: Clean external directories, absent root workspace and absent optional coordinator.
adapterScenarios.when: Install and run agent with explicit permitted local input only; separately run MCP with generic client.
adapterScenarios.then: Agent declares any absent domain capability rather than requiring paired MCP; MCP tools work without agent/model credentials. Record lockfiles, actual install/run/test commands and dependency graph.

adapterScenarios.given: Fixture internal/licensed source with use allowed but sharing/export denied; no live paid keys.
adapterScenarios.when: Analyze and attempt coordinator handoff/export.
adapterScenarios.then: Respect source rights in receiving scope, deny disallowed sharing/export and preserve provenance. Paid smoke proof remains opt-in; no claim of connector support from a stub.

adapterScenarios.given: A valid work-product record but a failed configured professional case or expired eval profile.
adapterScenarios.when: Swap employee/provider and attempt promotion.
adapterScenarios.then: Run same versioned role cases; failed/missing eval blocks promotion independent of valid transport/schema. Deterministic policy judges, expert professional judgment and optional configured LLM rubric stay separate.

adapterScenarios.given: An optional Chief of Staff with granted delegation and compatible external employee; no fleet authority.
adapterScenarios.when: Delegate one scoped task, receive work/review state, lose the employee connection and resume.
adapterScenarios.then: Delegation respects capabilities/policy; durable IDs and states survive; failed/unreviewed work cannot authorize downstream decisions and private context remains private.

adapterScenarios.given: A new SDK/protocol/runtime version and prior accepted fixture/role result bundle.
adapterScenarios.when: Propose adapter replacement including MCP 2026-07-28 or A2A 1.0.
adapterScenarios.then: Pin exact implementation/profile, rerun required compositions and trust/role cases; unsupported state/schema/auth/cancel semantics fail compatibility. Preserve stable 0.1.0 domain records; no latest aliases or silent adoption.
